name: event
title: Event
description: A full calendar: Month, Week, Day and Agenda views with drag to move, resize, overlap layout and an editable event model — frappe-ui's Calendar, ported to React on espresso primitives.

files.content:
export { Event, type EventProps } from "./event"
export { EventAgenda } from "./view-agenda"
export { EventDaily } from "./view-day"
export { EventMonthly } from "./view-month"
export { EventWeekly } from "./view-week"
export { EventGridPill } from "./grid-pill"
export { EventMonthPill } from "./month-pill"
export { EventPopover, EventModalContent } from "./event-popover"
export { NewEventModal } from "./event-modal"
export { EventTimeMarker } from "./time-marker"
export { EventContext, useEventContext } from "./context"
export { EventStyles } from "./styles"
export {
  useNow,
  useEventData,
  useHourGrid,
  useStripScroll,
  useActiveEvent,
  setActiveEvent,
  getActiveEvent,
} from "./hooks"
export { useEventBase } from "./use-event-base"
export * from "./types"
export {
  colorMap,
  eventColor,
  eventBgStyle,
  parseDate,
  calculateMinutes,
  convertMinutesToHours,
  calculateDiff,
  handleSeconds,
  formatTime,
  formattedDuration,
  formatMonthYear,
  getCalendarDates,
  monthList,
  daysList,
  daysListFull,
} from "./utils"
export {
  eventDays,
  eventDayCount,
  isAllDayLike,
  isOvernight,
  isSpan,
  daySegments,
  layoutRow,
  barsInColumn,
  shiftEventDays,
  shiftEventMinutes,
  stripPlacement,
  sortByStart,
  dayEvents,
  eventsOn,
  addDays,
  daysBetween,
} from "./span"
export { daySpan, rowTimeLabel, rowDescription, rowTiming, hasEnded } from "./row"
export {
  agendaMonths,
  agendaRange,
  agendaRows,
  agendaWeeks,
  agendaRangeLabel,
  type AgendaRow,
  type AgendaWeek,
} from "./agenda-days"
export { stripWeeks, stripRange, weekStart, shortMonth } from "./month-strip"
